name: @intellectual-frontiers/anyfs-bridge
description: The bridge of AnyFS: copy, sync, move, check, two-way sync and mirror between any two stores, planned before anything is changed, with the plan held to a hash, every write guarded by the revision it saw, and what a destination would not keep said beforehand.
